property_summary: For any admissible play (exactly 10 wei from a codeless EOA) at a timestamp where the on-chain randomness keccak(timestamp,difficulty)%2 equals 1, no payout may occur so the pot must still hold the ticket (pot == 10); the mutant's '% 1' forces the payout branch on every play, zeroing the pot, so it violates this rule for exactly those inputs where the true randomness is 1.
change_summary: Replace the modulo '% 2' with '% 1' so random is always 0 and the payout branch executes on every play.
